text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is an original research paper focused on land use and land cover (LULC) future prediction for China at the national scale. It integrates global socioeconomic and emission scenarios (SSPs and RCPs) to simulate land use changes from 2010 to 2100. The study implements eight scenarios combining SSPs and RCPs, enabling quantitative comparison of multiple futures. It employs spatially explicit modeling via coupling GCAM with the Future Land Use Simulation Model (FLUS) at 1 km resolution, producing mapped LULC projections. The study includes quantitative accuracy assessments (kappa coefficient, figure of merit) for the spatial downscaling model. The focus is explicitly on LULC prediction under alternative future pathways, with national-scale spatial implementation and scenario-based quantitative comparison. It is not a review, and does not meet any exclusion criteria such as global-only scale, single scenario, or lack of spatial explicitness. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and is categorized as OK.)
